The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他们住才一月就又搬家：才住了一个月，了completed

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Incorrect phrase: “他们住才一月就又搬家。” / Formula: Subject + 才 + 在 + place + 住了 + duration + 就 + 又 + verb / Correct: “他们才在那儿住了一个月，就又搬家了。”
Run 2: Incorrect phrase: “他们住才一月就又搬家。” Formula: Subject + 才 + 在 + Place + 住了 + duration + 就 + 又 + Verb + 了 Correct: “他们才在那儿住了一个月，就又搬家了。” “才……就……” shows that they moved again after only one month. Add “在那儿” for the place and “了” to show completed actions.

output.reason: Both runs identify the word-order and completion issue in the same sentence and provide the same acceptable correction.
